comment: Replicated. Four in-domain runs of mine, each with the paper predict() at error at or below 0.03 (bar 3 x 0.01): r2/001 (A-A, r0 = 9, T = 6, error 0.00503), r2/002 (C-C, r0 = 7, T = 6, error 0.00641), r2/003 (B-C, r0 = 8, T = 6, error 0.00496) and r3/003 (A-A, r0 = 6, T = 4, error 0.00507). Free fits (P = 2.5, full window): A-A at 9 gives 11.98 vs 12.28 (-2.4%); A-A at 6 gives 17.04 vs 17.24 (-1.2%); B-C at 8 gives K_BC -4.60 vs -4.47 (+2.8%), K_CB -7.80 vs -7.77 (+0.5%); C-C at 7 gives 10.71 vs 10.14 (+5.6%, the weakest point). Zero-force null errors: r2/001 0.030, r2/002 0.056, r2/003 0.017, r3/003 0.063. Scope: the claim holds at separations 6, 7, 8, 9 for these pairs. A-B and B-B at separation 7 are not covered; the A-B run at 7 is filed as 2026-11-21/r1/lab-vernier/010 for a later review. The predicted_error 0.01 is loose for T = 4 to 6 pair runs of this kind.
